letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your smile lights up the skyscrapers and the spice markets alike, and your laughter is the soundtrack of my heart. Even when the calendar flips to another day, my love for you stays timeless—just like our favorite date tucked between the sand and the mango trees. Thank you for being my endless adventure, my sweet cutie, my forever home.
poem:
In dunes or by the Ganges' flow,  
Your love’s the compass I always know.  
From sunrise glow to night’s soft sigh,  
With you, my heart learns how to fly.
